models.boundary_policy: Inclusive0.25–1000keV per ion; use analytic one-sided values at boundaries. Outside domain raise an error; no clamping, extrapolation or invented sub-grid response.
models.coordinate: natural logarithm of total kinetic energy in keV per ion
models.model_assumptions: Cubic B-spline QF versus logE; coefficients constrained to[0,1] and nondecreasing. This is a smoothing/monotonic-QF assumption, not a new SRIM simulation.
models.uncertainty: Variance-corrected paired independent-batch bootstrap at each energy, preserving primary/recoil covariance. Conditional on chosen basis, penalty and shape constraints; no gas-transfer, SRIM-model, cutoff or detector-calibration uncertainty included.
